strings.큰 비커에 부어요. 두 비커 모두 빨강은 20mL로 똑같아요!: to pour it into the big one. Both beakers have exactly 20mL of red!
strings.그래서 빨강과 노랑의 비는?: So what is the ratio of red to yellow?
strings.🖌️ 물감 단추를 누른 다음 칸을 누르면 그 색으로 칠해져요 · 한 번: 🖌️ Tap a paint button, then tap a square to paint it · tap it again to erase
strings.🖌️ 물감 단추를 누른 다음 칸을 누르면 그 색으로 칠해져요: 🖌️ Tap a paint button, then tap a square to paint it
strings.손가락이나 마우스로 누른 채 끌어서: hold it down with your finger or mouse and drag it
strings.황금비의 앞 두 자리예요. 왼쪽부터 차례로 기억해 두세요!: These are the first two digits of the golden ratio. Remember them in order, left to right!
strings.틀린 가설은 목록에서 지워 뒀어요: The ones proved wrong have been crossed off
strings.빨강은 한 컵, 노랑은 두 컵이 되었구나. 같은 양인데 세는 단위를 바꾸: So the red came to one cup and the yellow to two. The amounts are just the same, but change the unit you count in and new numbers appear. So what is the ratio of red to yellow? Choose below.
strings.노을 진 하늘을 칠하다 말았어요: The sunset sky was left half painted
strings.안녕? 나는 화가 뭉크야. 「절규」의 노을 진 하늘을 칠해야 하는데 물감: Hello there. I am Munch, a painter. I still have the sunset sky of The Scream to paint, but my paint has dried up.
strings.과학자 먼셀이 주황색을 만들어 주겠다고 했어. 너도 도와줄래?: Munsell the scientist said he would make the orange for me. Will you help too?
strings.먼셀 20색상환 — 빨강·주황·노랑·초록·파랑·보라 스무 가지 색이 원을: Munsell’s 20-hue color circle — twenty colors from red and orange through yellow, green, blue and purple, arranged in a ring with their names and values
strings.안녕? 만나서 반가워. 나는 색깔을 연구하는 과학자 먼셀이야. 이 색상환: Hello, good to meet you. I am Munsell, a scientist who studies color. I made this color wheel.
strings.나와 함께 뭉크의 노을색을 만들어볼까?: Shall we make Munch’s sunset color together?
Let us find it by experiment.
strings.아래 두 비커에 빨강 물감을 20mL 넣었어. 여기에 노랑 물감을 다르게: I have put 20mL of red into both beakers below. Now we add different amounts of yellow: 20mL on the left, 60mL on the right. Watch what happens to the color.
strings.과학자는 실험 전에 가설을 세워. 가설은 어떻게 될지 미리 예상해 보는: A scientist makes a hypothesis before an experiment. A hypothesis is a guess about what will happen. Look closely at the target color. Which color looks like there is more of it?
strings.어떤 색이 더 많아 보이는지 잘 관찰해 보세요: Look closely: which color seems to be more?
strings.🔴 빨강이 더 많아 보여요: 🔴 There looks to be more red
strings.빨강이 많으면 이렇게 진하고 붉은 주황이 된단다. 목표색과 나란히 놓고: With more red you get a deep, reddish orange like this. Shall we put it beside the target color?
strings.🟡 노랑이 더 많아 보여요: 🟡 There looks to be more yellow
strings.노랑이 많으면 이렇게 밝고 환한 주황이 된단다. 목표색과 나란히 놓고 비: With more yellow you get a bright, light orange like this. Shall we put it beside the target color?
strings.반반이면 딱 중간 주황이 된단다. 목표색과 나란히 놓고 비교해 볼까?: Half and half gives an orange right in the middle. Shall we put it beside the target color?
strings.목표색을 만들기 위해 빨강 물감 10mL씩 두 컵을 부었어. 노랑 물감은: To make the target color, I poured two cups of red paint, 10mL each. How many 10mL cups of yellow paint do we need? Add or take away 1 cup at a time, find the target color, and write it down!
strings.노랑 쪽 ＋를 눌러 한 컵씩 부어요: Tap ＋ on the yellow side to pour one cup at a time
strings.완벽해. 그런데 같은 색을 다른 양으로도 만들 수 있을까? 이번에는 빨강: Perfect. But can we make the same color with different amounts? This time I poured three cups of red, 10mL each. How many 10mL cups of yellow will make the same color as before?
strings.빨강이 세 컵이 되었어요 · 노랑은 몇 컵일까요: Now there are three cups of red · how many cups of yellow?
strings.좋아! 이번에는 빨강 물감을 10mL씩 네 컵 부었어. 노랑 물감은 10: Good! This time I poured four cups of red, 10mL each. How many 10mL cups of yellow will make the same color?
strings.빨강이 네 컵이 되었어요 · 노랑은 몇 컵일까요: Now there are four cups of red · how many cups of yellow?
strings.아주 잘하고 있어! 마지막으로 뭉크가 쓸 물감을 큰 통에 가득 만들어 보: You're doing really well! Last of all, let's fill a big tub with paint for Munch. If we put 50mL of red in the big tub, how much yellow do we need for the target color?
strings.10mL 컵으로 노랑을 부어요: Pour the yellow with the 10mL cup
strings.이번엔 다른 방법을 실험해 보자. 주황을 만들고 각 물감을 같은 양으로: Now let's try a different way. What happens if we make orange and then add the same amount of each paint? Will the color stay the same or change? Right now there is 20mL of red and 40mL of yellow. Add 30mL more red and 30mL more yellow, then compare it with the target color.
strings.빨강도 세 컵, 노랑도 세 컵 더 부어요: Pour three more cups of red and three more of yellow
strings.왼쪽은 빨강 20, 노랑 40에 각각 2를 곱한 양으로 섞어 만든 색이야: The color on the left was made by multiplying red 20 and yellow 40 each by 2. The color on the right was made by adding 30mL to red 20 and to yellow 40. What should we do to make the same color? Drag the word cards into the blanks to finish the sentence.
strings.빨강 20에 노랑 40을, 빨강 30에 노랑 60을, 빨강 40에 노랑: Red 20 with yellow 40, red 30 with yellow 60, and red 40 with yellow 80 all made the target color, right? Now make the target color with different amounts. [[Move the slider with the mouse or tap ＋－|Move the slider with the mouse or tap the plus and minus buttons]] to set the amounts, and when you get the target color, tap Record it!
strings.미션 · 앞과 다른 양으로 목표색 만들기 · 슬라이더나 ＋－로 1mL씩: Mission · make the target color with different amounts · use the slider or ＋－ to change 1mL at a time
strings.이전과 또 다른 양으로 목표색을 만들어 봐. [[마우스로 슬라이더를 움직: Now make the target color with yet another amount. [[Move the slider with the mouse or tap ＋－|Move the slider with the mouse or tap the plus and minus buttons]] to set the amounts, and when you get the target color, tap Record it!
strings.미션 · 지금까지와 또 다른 양으로 목표색 만들기: Mission · make the target color with yet another amount
strings.실험으로 찾은 빨강 20mL와 노랑 40mL를 다시 가져왔어. 이번에는: Here are the 20mL of red and 40mL of yellow you found by experiment. This time I will give you a slightly bigger cup that holds 20mL. If you move all the paint from both beakers into these cups, how many cups will each one fill? Tap the cups and move it across yourself.
strings.빈 컵을 누르면 비커에서 20mL가 옮겨져요: Tap an empty cup and 20mL moves across from the beaker
strings.이번에는 빨강 40mL를 기준으로 해 보자. 40mL짜리 컵으로 나눠 담: This time let's use 40mL of red as the base. If we pour them into 40mL cups, how many cups will each be?
Shall we look back at what you just did? Answer the three questions below.
strings.🤔 방금 한 일을 짚어 봐요: 🤔 Look back at what you just did
strings.🤔 방금 한 일을 짚어 볼까: 🤔 Let us look back at what you just did
strings.어떻게 해서 1컵과 2컵이 되었나요?: How did it come out as 1 cup and 2 cups?
strings.빨강을 덜어 내고 노랑을 더 넣었어요: I took some red out and put more yellow in
strings.물감은 한 방울도 덜어 내거나 더 넣지 않았단다. 세는 단위만 바꾸었지?: Not one drop was taken out or added. All that changed was the unit you counted in.
strings.정해진 크기의 컵으로 두 비커를 모두 옮겨 담았어요: I moved both beakers using cups of one set size
strings.양은 그대로인데 왜 1과 2라는 새로운 수가 보였을까요?: The amounts did not change, so why did the new numbers 1 and 2 appear?
The paint only moved from beaker to cup — none of it went away.
strings.컵이 비커보다 작기 때문이에요: Because the cup is smaller than the beaker
strings.컵이 작다는 것만으로는 1과 2가 나오지 않는단다. 무엇을 한 묶음으로: A smaller cup on its own does not give you 1 and 2. Shall we look again at what size bundle you counted in?
strings.컵 하나를 한 묶음으로 세었기 때문이에요: Because we counted one cup as one bundle
strings.손으로 옮긴 이 일을 수로 나타내면 어느 것일까요?: Which numbers show what you just did with your hands?
strings.빨강 1컵과 노랑 2컵: 1 cup of red and 2 cups of yellow
strings.두 양을 더한 값이란다. 우리가 한 일은 두 양을 비교해 본 것이지?: That is the two amounts added together. What we did was compare the two amounts, wasn't it?
strings.두 양의 차란다. 우리가 한 일은 두 양을 비교해 본 것이지?: That is the difference between the two amounts. What we did was compare the two amounts, wasn't it?
strings.두 번 다 네가 만들어 낸 [[1컵과 2컵|한 컵과 두 컵]]에 이름을: Both times you made 1 cup and 2 cups. Let me give that a name. Comparing two amounts like this is called a “ratio”. We write the two numbers with a colon between them. Drag the word cards below to fill in the blanks.
strings.📝 두 수 사이에 쌍점을 찍어 적어요: 📝 Write a colon between the two numbers
strings.우리가 목표색을 만들었던 빨강과 노랑의 값을 표로 만들었어. 예를 들어: I made a table of the red and yellow amounts that gave us the target color. For example, if red is 10mL and yellow is 20mL, you do it like this. Now plot the points for red 20, 30, 40 and 50, each with its yellow.
strings.📈 빨강 눈금과 노랑 눈금을 차례로 눌러 점을 찍어요: 📈 Tap a red mark, then a yellow mark, to plot a point
strings.점을 모두 찍었구나! 이제 첫 번째 점부터 차례로 눌러 선으로 이어 보자: You plotted all the points! Now tap them in order, starting from the first point, to join them with a line. And if red were 60, how much yellow would we need? You can find it on the graph without doing an experiment. Follow the line, find the spot for red 60 and tap it. Then fill in the blank in the equation on the right.
strings.📈 점을 차례로 눌러 선으로 잇고, 빨강 60 자리와 식의 빈칸을 채워요: 📈 Tap the points in order to join them, then find red 60 and fill in the equation
strings.선 위의 점들은 모두 목표색이 되었지? 그럼 선에서 벗어난 자리는 어떤: The points on the line all made the target color, right? Then what color are the spots off the line? Tap two spots off the line on the grid and check the color.
strings.📈 선 밖의 자리를 눌러 색을 확인해요 · 두 군데: 📈 Tap spots off the line to check the color · two spots
strings.🤔 선 위와 선 밖을 견주어 볼까: 🤔 Let's compare on the line and off the line
strings.선 위의 점들은 왜 모두 목표색과 같았을까요?: Why were all the points on the line the same as the target color?
strings.빨강과 노랑의 비가 모두 1 대 2로 같아서요: Because red to yellow is the same for all of them, 1 to 2
strings.점이 모두 한 줄에 놓여 있어서요: Because the points are all in one line
strings.한 줄에 놓인 것은 눈에 보이는 결과란다. 그 점들의 빨강과 노랑을 견주: Being in one line is what you can see. If you compare red and yellow at those points, what stays the same?
strings.노랑이 빨강보다 많아서요: Because there is more yellow than red
strings.선 밖에도 노랑이 더 많은 자리가 있었어. 그런데도 색이 달랐지?: Off the line there were spots with more yellow too. But the color was different, wasn't it?
strings.선에서 벗어난 자리는 왜 다른 색이 되었을까요?: Why did the spots off the line become a different color?
strings.물감의 양이 너무 적어서요: Because there is too little paint
strings.양이 많은 자리를 눌러도 색이 달랐단다. 양이 아니라 무엇이 달라졌는지: Even spots with lots of paint had a different color. If it wasn't the amount, what changed? Shall we look again?
strings.빨강과 노랑의 비가 1 대 2가 아니어서요: Because red to yellow is not 1 to 2
strings.점이 선 위에 없어서요: Because the points are not on the line
strings.선은 비가 1 대 2인 자리를 이어 놓은 것이란다. 그 자리를 벗어나면: The line joins the spots where the ratio is 1 to 2. When you move off it, what changes?
strings.이제 빨강과 노랑을 몇 대 몇의 비율로 섞으면 그 색이 만들어지는지 뭉크: Now write to Munch and tell him what ratio of red to yellow makes the color. Hold the number cards below and drag them onto the blanks.
I painted the sunset with the color you gave me, and it is finished.
strings.폴 시냐크, 「펠릭스 페네옹의 초상」(1890): Paul Signac, Portrait of Félix Fénéon (1890)
strings.뭉크의 색을 함께 만들어 줘서 고마워. 빨강과 노랑을 1 대 2로 섞으면: Thank you for making Munch's color with me. You found out yourself that red and yellow mixed 1 to 2 give the same color, even in different amounts.
Look at this picture. It was made with little dots of paint, without mixing the paints.
strings.이번에는 점을 찍어 색을 만드는 화가를 도와줄래? 우리가 함께 공부한 비: Now will you help a painter who makes colors with dots? If you remember the ratio we learned together, you'll be able to help.
strings.폴 시냐크, 「양산을 든 여인」 — 주황이 빠진 미완성: Paul Signac, Woman with a Parasol — unfinished, with the orange missing
Hello! I'm Signac, a painter who makes color out of dots.
I'm painting Woman with a Parasol right now, but I don't have the orange for it yet.
strings.같이 점을 찍어 주황을 만들어 줄래?: Will you make orange with me, dot by dot?
strings.나는 빨강과 노랑의 비가 2 대 3으로 주황을 만들고 싶어. 다섯 칸을: I want to make orange with red and yellow in a ratio of 2 to 3. Using five squares, show red and yellow with dots.
strings.점 5칸 — 비를 지켜 찍어 봐요: 5 dots — keep the ratio as you place them
strings.🤔 방금 찍은 점을 짚어 볼까: 🤔 Let us look back at the dots you just placed
strings.어떻게 해서 이 주황이 되었나요?: How did this orange come about?
strings.아무 색이나 다섯 개를 찍었어요: I placed any five dots at all
strings.색을 아무렇게나 찍으면 이 주황이 안 나와. 각 색을 몇 개씩 찍었는지: Dots placed at random do not give this orange. Shall we count how many of each color you placed?
strings.빨강 점 2개와 노랑 점 3개를 찍었어요: I placed 2 red dots and 3 yellow dots
strings.빨강 점 4개와 노랑 점 6개를 찍으면 색이 어떻게 될까요?: What happens to the color if you place 4 red dots and 6 yellow dots?
strings.같은 주황이 돼요 — 빨강과 노랑의 비가 2 : 3으로 같으니까요: It's the same orange — red to yellow is still 2 : 3
strings.더 진한 주황이 돼요 — 점을 더 많이 찍었으니까요: It's a deeper orange — because there are more dots
strings.점 수가 늘어도 빨강과 노랑의 비가 그대로면 같은 주황이야. 두 수를 간: Even with more dots, if red to yellow stays the same, it's the same orange. Shall we simplify the two numbers?
strings.노랑에 더 가까워져요 — 노랑 점이 더 많아졌으니까요: It gets closer to yellow — because there are more yellow dots
strings.빨강도 2개에서 4개로 함께 늘었어. 빨강과 노랑의 비를 다시 견주어 볼: Red went up too, from 2 to 4. Shall we compare red to yellow again?
strings.내가 찍은 점을 기호로 쓰면 어느 것일까요?: Which symbols say what your dots show?
strings.앞에는 빨강 점 수, 뒤에는 노랑 점 수를 놓는 거야. 순서를 다시 볼까: The red dots go first, the yellow dots second. Shall we check the order?
strings.전체는 다섯 개야. 지금 비교한 건 빨강과 노랑이지?: The whole is five. What we compared just now was red and yellow, right?
strings.이번에도 빨강 : 노랑을 2 대 3으로 주황을 만들 거야. 이번에는 열: Again we'll make orange with red : yellow at 2 to 3. This time, color in ten squares.
strings.이번에는 100칸을 색칠할 거야. [[빨강 : 노랑 = 2 : 3|빨강: This time we'll color 100 squares. Color them so that [[red : yellow = 2 : 3|red to yellow is 2 to 3]].
strings.큰 붓을 쓰면 한 줄씩 칠할 수 있어요: With the big brush you can paint a whole row at a time
strings.🤔 방금 칠한 백 칸을 짚어 볼까: 🤔 Let us look back at the hundred squares you painted
strings.백 칸을 어떻게 칠했나요?: How did you paint the hundred squares?
strings.빨강 40칸, 노랑 60칸으로 나누어 칠했어요: I split them into 40 red and 60 yellow
strings.한 칸씩 아무 데나 칠했어요: I painted squares here and there, one at a time
strings.칠한 자리는 달라도 좋아. 그런데 각 색을 몇 칸 칠했는지가 색을 정하지: Where you paint them can vary. What decides the color is how many squares of each. Shall we count again?
strings.칸이 열 칸에서 백 칸으로 늘었는데 왜 같은 주황일까요?: The squares went from ten to a hundred, so why is it the same orange?
strings.칸이 많아져서 색이 더 진해졌기 때문이에요: Because more squares made the color deeper
strings.칸이 많아져도 색은 그대로였지? 무엇이 변하지 않았는지 다시 볼까?: The color stayed the same with more squares, did it not? Shall we look again at what did not change?
strings.칸 수가 늘어도 빨강과 노랑의 비가 2 대 3 그대로이기 때문이에요: Because however many squares there are, red to yellow stays 2 to 3
strings.백 칸에 칠한 것을 기호로 쓰면 어느 것일까요?: Which symbols say what you painted on the hundred squares?
strings.40과 100은 빨강과 전체를 비교한 거야. 지금은 빨강과 노랑을 비교하: 40 and 100 compare red with the whole. Right now we are comparing red with yellow, right?
